content: Captain, Cook just lost his hat in the card game. He's wearing a bucket now.
Someone's playing the accordion on deck. Badly.
Can we name the new cloud formation after you, Captain?
The crew wants to have a talent show tonight. Will you judge?
Cook says if you smile once this week he'll make pie.
The navigator taught the parrot to say 'storm ahead'. It won't stop.
We found a barrel of old sky-charts. Some of them have doodles of you.
Captain, the deckhands are racing paper airships off the bow.
The engineer swears the engine hums in tune if you sing to it.
Is it true you once flew the Kestrel upside down? The new hands are asking.
The crew made you a hat. It has feathers. Many feathers.
Someone hid all the spoons. We're eating soup with forks.
There's a betting pool on whether you'll laugh before we reach port.
The parrot just insulted the navigator. Everyone's crying laughing.
Can I teach you a card trick, Captain?
Cook made 'celebration stew'. Nobody knows what we're celebrating.
The sunset tonight is ridiculous. Pink and gold everywhere.
Deckhand Pell is trying to juggle wrenches.
The crew wants a ship motto. Ideas?
Captain, the wind just stole Pell's journal. It's halfway to the clouds.
Music night! Requests?
We're playing charades. Your turn, Captain.
The navigator claims he can see a cloud shaped like you. It's frowning.
Cook's pie actually turned out good. You should have some.
Someone painted a smiley face on the cargo crate.
The parrot learned your name. It says it like a question.
Can we fly low over the lake? The crew wants to wave at the fishermen.
The engineer is giving a speech about bolts. He's very passionate.
Is there such a thing as an airship holiday? Asking for the whole crew.
Pell finally beat Cook at cards. Cook demands a rematch.
The stars out here are unreal tonight.
Captain, the crew wants to know your favorite song.
Somebody tied bells to the rigging. It sounds like a sleigh.
We've decided the parrot is now the first officer. Sorry, me.
The crew says thank you for the good weather, like you arranged it.
Last game of the night: who can tell the worst joke?
Okay, Captain, your joke. Go.
Pell made a toast to 'the grumpiest, best captain in the skies'.
Everyone's asleep except the parrot.
Calm night. Quiet engines. Feels good.
Morning, Captain. Coffee's strong today.
Cook wants to know if you'd like the last of the pie.
The new hands are learning knots. It's going about as well as you'd think.
Someone wrote you a little song. It rhymes 'captain' with 'nappin''.
The sky's completely clear. First time in days.
Pell asked if you've ever been scared up here.
The crew's playing music again. Softer this time.
The navigator says we're making great time.
Can I take the wheel for a bit? I'll be careful.
